_comment: Corrections applied on top of products.json, keyed by b2b_product_id.
products.json is regenerated from the B2BWave export by script/extract_b2bwave.py,
so it must stay a faithful copy of that export. Anything we know to be wrong in the
source data is fixed here instead, where the reason is visible and survives re-extraction.
Reviewed by the operator; safe to commit (no personal data).
A "discontinued": true entry takes a product off the storefront without deleting it.

_why: B2BWave shipped this product with the placeholder SKU '-'. The operator's master
SKU sheet identifies it as the 10-count Green Apple Supreme THC-free gummies.
The export also listed price 25.00, which is the RETAIL price for a 10 pack --
a retail figure that leaked into the wholesale price list. Operator confirmed the
wholesale price is 12.50, matching the Supreme Formula 10ct at the same count.
Without this, every wholesale customer would be charged double.
Advanced Gelcaps (30 count) is no longer manufactured (operator, 2026-08-25).
Discontinued rather than deleted: it appears in five years of wholesale order
history and in the retail sales data, and deleting the product would orphan
those line items. Spree::Product.available filters on discontinue_on, so this
removes it from the storefront, the search index and the homepage ranking.
The 60-count gelcaps are already absent from the B2BWave catalog export.

Discontinued rather than deleted, for the same reason as 304: the product
stays referenced by history and stays visible in the admin.
Neither gallon size has any wholesale order history or retail sales, so
hiding them changes no ranking -- they only ever appeared in the catalog
listing and the Tinctures nav.
